# Feature examples

## Project-format change

Request: Add a persistent plugin parameter.

Update the plugin descriptor and project schema. Define migration, import,
undo, round-trip, and acceptance behavior. Implement them only when the user
requests implementation.

## Visual change

Request: Add a compact rack control.

Define its faceplate location, command, keyboard path, theme behavior, and
supported layout. Require component and production-browser evidence.

## Technical change

Request: Use a browser API that differs across engines.

Verify current primary sources for Chrome, Edge, and Firefox. Record the
support contract, fallback, user error, and verification method.
